name: the-system-player
description: The System — Player Edition. Your job hunt becomes a solo-leveling RPG inside your own Notion workspace: postings become quests, interviews become boss fights, follow-ups have SLAs, and every action banks XP that is never re-scored. Start with /awaken — the tutorial questline that builds your world and levels you to 4 by the end of setup. Draft-only by design: it never sends anything on your behalf, and your job-search data never leaves your own workspace.
